svg.title: PRIM3 objective-centered tactical training map
svg.desc: A top-down teaching map with the X and Y axes crossing at exact screen center. The disclosed stationary objective is at zero, zero. Entry starts at minus six, minus three; Recon at six, minus three; Technical at zero, nine. Illustrative cover and four adjacent interaction tiles are shown. This is a proposed coach reference, not a playable or balanced game.
svg.text: E vs R vs T · One objective. One coordinate frame.
All three roles can score. Training outcomes stay in the simulation.
